_comment: S3 — primary local-geometry bakeoff. Full frozen set: 6 clips x 48 frames. Reference is the Week-3 persisted range product, a PROVISIONAL MULTI-VIEW HYPOTHESIS. 'Error' means disagreement with that hypothesis, never objective error.
no_master_score: FREEZE 6: no weighted master score. The six dimensions are reported separately and reduction (§19) is by explicit multi-dimensional reasons.
m1a_bins: provisional Week-3 reference-range metres (NOT validated pre-C2)
m1b_bins: scale-invariant quantiles of each clip's pooled reference range
